name: @glyphh-ai/desktop
description: Glyphh — a desktop AI workspace that runs on your own model keys, entirely on your machine.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-ipc-registered.mjs && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:skill-flow && npm run build:code-workbench && npm run build:monaco && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:cli: tsc -p cli/tsconfig.json && rm -rf dist/cli && esbuild cli/src/main.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --jsx=automatic --outfile=dist/cli/main.mjs --sourcemap --external:ink --external:react
scripts.build:code-workbench: esbuild src/renderer/code-workbench.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/code-workbench-bundle.js --platform=browser && esbuild src/renderer/pdf-raster.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/pdf-raster.js --platform=browser --format=iife && esbuild node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.mjs --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/pdf-raster-worker.js --platform=browser --format=esm --minify && shx cp src/renderer/pdf-raster.html dist/renderer/
scripts.build:renderer: tsc -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-renderer-emit.mjs && shx cp src/renderer/styles.css src/renderer/browser.html src/renderer/thinking.html node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css dist/renderer/ && shx cp -r src/renderer/fonts dist/renderer/ && shx cp -r src/renderer/brand dist/renderer/ && esbuild scripts/chart-global.mjs --bundle --format=iife --minify --platform=browser --outfile=dist/renderer/app-libs/chart.js && node scripts/assemble-home.mjs
scripts.build:web: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:skill-flow && npm run build:code-workbench && npm run build:monaco && npm run build:web-bridge && npm run build:web-mobile
scripts.build:web-bridge: esbuild web/src/bridge.js --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/glyphh-web-bundle.js --platform=browser --format=iife --sourcemap --define:__GLYPHH_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\" && shx cp web/github-done.html web/artifact.html dist/renderer/
scripts.build:web-mobile: esbuild web/src/mobile.tsx --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/glyphh-mobile.js --platform=browser --format=iife --jsx=automatic --sourcemap --define:__GLYPHH_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\" && shx cp web/mobile.html web/mobile.css dist/renderer/ && shx cp web/pwa/manifest.webmanifest web/pwa/sw.js dist/renderer/ && shx mkdir -p dist/renderer/brand/icons && shx cp web/pwa/icons/icon-192.png web/pwa/icons/icon-512.png web/pwa/icons/icon-180.png dist/renderer/brand/icons/
scripts.build:mobile: shx mkdir -p dist/renderer && shx cp -r src/renderer/brand src/renderer/fonts dist/renderer/ && npm run build:web-mobile
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:web && npm run web
scripts.build:sdk: npm --prefix packages/glyphh-sdk ci && npm --prefix packages/glyphh-sdk run build
scripts.prepack: npm run build:sdk && rm -rf node_modules/@glyphh/sdk && mkdir -p node_modules/@glyphh/sdk && cp -R packages/glyphh-sdk/package.json packages/glyphh-sdk/dist node_modules/@glyphh/sdk/

author: Glyphh AI
